title: [dynamo] RelationalGuard classes store raw PyObject* without proper reference counting
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug ## 🐛 Bug Similar to #156527, there are dangling pointer issues in `torch/csrc/dynamo/guards.cpp` where `PyObject*` pointers are stored without incrementing reference counts. ### Affected Classes 1. **OBJECT_ALIASING** (line 2259-2282) - Stores `PyObject* _first_tensor` without `Py_INCREF` - Can become dangling after `torch._dynamo.reset()` ```cpp bool check_nopybind(PyObject* value) override { // borrowed ref if (_is_first_call) { _first_tensor = value; _is_first_call = false; return true; } return _first_tensor == value; } void reset_state() final { _is_first_call = true; } private: bool _is_first_call{true}; PyObject* _first_tensor{nullptr}; }; ``` ## Proposed Solution Following the pattern from #156527: - Replace PyObject* with py::object for automatic reference counting - Update OBJECT_ALIASING::_first_tensor to use py::object ## Environment - PyTorch Version: main branch - File: torch/csrc/dynamo/guards.cpp ## Additional context This issue was found while investigating similar patterns to PR #156527. The fix should follow the same approach of using pybind11's py::object for proper lifetime management. I have a fix ready and can submit a PR if this issue is confirmed. cc @jansel @anijain2305 (reviewers of #156527) ### Versions
